item: the :8765 lab board cannot show the scheduled-task probe. (1) find the lab UI's status source, identify the ONE fetch the board already makes and its file, add a fetch of gateway GET /status (t39's route) and render warning != null as a visible WARNING row (plain DOM, match the board's existing row style). (2) intentional-vs-silent disablement: make the probe respect a marker file (logs/magimprove_intentional.flag) so intentional disablement does not alarm; check the lifecycle code first for where the disable happens.
note: Half 1: the board is dashboard/static/health.html (LOOP HEALTH, linked from home.html System card). It makes exactly ONE fetch: /api/v1/loop/health (line 65). Added loadGatewayStatus(): fetches gateway GET http://127.0.0.1:8001/status?key=mag-local-dev-key (gateway is FastAPI on 8001 with CORS allow-*; api_gateway's key gate accepts ?key= for the operator's board page, default key per MAG_API_KEY contract; page JS cannot read server env so the documented loopback default is used and an override degrades to the honest muted row, never a fake alarm). Render rule: warning != null = visible WARNING kv row with pill warn (the renderCadence row style); warning == null = ok row naming statuses plus intentional markers; gateway down/401 = muted pill faint row. Refreshes on the same 30s cadence. Plain DOM, no framework. Half 2 negative finding first: NO code disables MagImproveDaily anywhere in the repo; lifecycle.py:514 is remediation prose in _waste_action (the operator runs the disable), and reconcile() explicitly skips improve (no auto-kill). So the marker contract was built at the truthful seam: mag/lifecycle.py gains mark_improve_intentional()/improve_intentional()/improve_intentional_flag_path() writing logs/magimprove_intentional.flag (JSON ts+reason+by), with a t47 spec block in the module docstring and a pointer comment at the :514 remediation naming the marker obligation; mag/doctor.check_scheduled_tasks (t20 probe) now takes the marker into account: Disabled + marker = ok (state, not alarm, payload surfaced under result 'intentional'), MISSING still alarms even with the marker (disable is not delete), and the gateway /status payload carries the new intentional key for the board. Spec lines landed first in each touched file (module docstring + function docstring). Live machine truth: real probe Ready; Disabled+marker suppression and Disabled-without-marker alarm both verified live then the marker file was cleaned up. Added lines are em-dash free (grep over git diff added lines: 0).
